crossRefs.note: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer…
They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of…

parallels.note: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of…

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

translations.web: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
translations.bsb: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon, they designated these cities by name
translations.kjv: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
